brief:
Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor have produced a documentary examining artificial intelligence systems used by the Israeli military in Gaza, The Guardian reported. The film features interviews with military insiders discussing what the filmmakers characterize as AI-assisted targeting that results in civilian casualties.

The Israeli government has reportedly sought to prevent distribution of the work. Abraham and Szor discuss their findings in a podcast accompanying the film's release.
dek: Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor on their new film interviewing Israeli military insiders on the vast, AI-assisted systems their sources say are being used to kill civilians in Gaza.
title: Israeli filmmakers reveal military AI systems targeting Gaza civilians
